kind: method (what a client can do today with the existing generic APIs)

checks: nonce is a non-negative integer or decimal string
Recognize confirmed/included/pending; failed or unrecognized values are indeterminate.
Before issuing any receipt, reject tx.status=pending as indeterminate even if getTransactionStatus.state=included, because the two reads disagree.
state == included, else indeterminate (failed/rejected/unknown/pending are never accepted)

result_states.finalized (this provider's label): block.status == confirmed AND tx status == confirmed
result_states.included: After every check passes, including the explicit pending rejection: tx status is confirmed or included and the block is confirmed or derived; otherwise indeterminate.
result_states.indeterminate: any check fails or any read errors, including tx.status=pending

pending_and_dropped: not demonstrated by captures: the inspected client code rejects pending/unknown/inconsistent observations; there is no pending or dropped transaction capture in this package
honest_limit: every input is a single node's self-report. "finalized" here means the node said "confirmed" for both block and transaction; no validator signature, signer pool or quorum is checked, and getTransactionStatus alone cannot distinguish an included-but-failed transfer (see N07)
